Ex: My main specialization was literature.

viewpoint

(noun). quan điểm

Ex: Try looking at things from a different viewpoint.

commercial

(adjective). mang tính thương mại

Ex: She is developing the commercial side of the organization.

exemplify

(verb). làm ví dụ cho

Ex: His food exemplifies Italian cooking at its best.

supply

(verb). cung cấp

Ex: The company supplied schools with sports equipment.

survive

(verb). Sống sót, tồn tại

Ex: They spent two months in the jungle, surviving on small animals and fruit.

floral

(adjective). thuộc về hoa

Ex: Floral tributes were sent to the church.

distribute

(verb). phân bổ, phân phối

Ex: Generous workspaces must be well distributed throughout the library.

favorable

(adjective). thuận lợi, có ích

Ex: The weather was favorable for a barbecue outside.

finding

(noun). Sự tìm ra, sự khám phá, điều tìm thấy

Ex: Our research findings indicate that pregnant women benefit from this treatment.

habitat

(noun). Môi trường sống

Ex: The panda's natural habitat is the bamboo forest.

patchwork

(noun). sự chắp vá, kết nối

Ex: From the plane, the landscape was just a patchwork of fields.

research

(noun). nghiên cứu

Ex: His researches in the field of disease prevention produced unexpected results.

resource

(noun). Nguồn tài nguyên

Ex: They promote the use of renewable resources like soybean oil.

suburban

(adjective). thuộc về vùng ngoại ô

Ex: They live in suburban Washington.

variety

(noun). Sự đa dạng

Ex: This tool can be used in a variety of ways.
